// ============================================================================
//  LINE MODEL
// ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
//  An ordered array, not a Map keyed by product: the same product legitimately
//  appears twice on one order (10 at retail, 2 as free samples), and a note
//  line has no product at all. lineNumber is DERIVED at submit from array
//  position — storing it would mean every insert renumbers everything below,
//  and a stale copy is a silent wrong-order bug.
// ============================================================================
const SOITEM_TYPE_SALE = 10;
const SOITEM_TYPE_DROP_SHIP = 12;
const SOITEM_TYPE_KIT = 80;

function newLineId() { return 'L' + (++_lineSeq); }
function lineById(id) { return _lines.find(l => l.lineId === id) || null; }
function lineIndex(id) { return _lines.findIndex(l => l.lineId === id); }

function makeSaleLine(product, qty) {
    return {
        lineId: newLineId(), kind: 'sale',
        product, qty: qty > 0 ? qty : 1, uomCode: product.uomCode || 'ea',
        taxable: product.taxableFlag !== false,
        listPrice: product.price, unitPrice: product.price,
        priceSource: 'product',
        ruleId: null, ruleName: '', ruleAuto: false, ruleLocked: false,
        // Set when the operator picks "None" outright. Distinct from "no rule
        // chosen yet": a cleared line must STAY at list price through a qty
        // change instead of quietly picking a rule back up.
        ruleCleared: false,
        choices: null, choicesKey: '', choicesState: 'idle',
        text: '',
    };
}
function makeNoteLine(text) {
    return { lineId: newLineId(), kind: 'note', text: text || '', product: null, qty: 0 };
}

function insertLine(line, afterLineId) {
    if (afterLineId == null || afterLineId === '') { _lines.push(line); return line; }
    const i = lineIndex(afterLineId);
    if (i < 0) _lines.push(line); else _lines.splice(i + 1, 0, line);
    return line;
}
function insertLineBefore(line, beforeLineId) {
    const i = lineIndex(beforeLineId);
    if (i < 0) _lines.push(line); else _lines.splice(i, 0, line);
    return line;
}
function removeLine(lineId) {
    const i = lineIndex(lineId);
    if (i >= 0) _lines.splice(i, 1);
    renderGrid(); refreshTotals();
}
function moveLine(lineId, beforeLineId) {
    const from = lineIndex(lineId);
    if (from < 0) return;
    const [l] = _lines.splice(from, 1);
    if (beforeLineId == null) { _lines.push(l); }
    else {
        const to = lineIndex(beforeLineId);
        if (to < 0) _lines.push(l); else _lines.splice(to, 0, l);
    }
    renderGrid(); refreshTotals();
}

async function addProductLine(product, afterLineId) {
    if (product.kitFlag || product.defaultSoItemType === SOITEM_TYPE_KIT || product.defaultSoItemType === SOITEM_TYPE_DROP_SHIP) {
        toast('“' + product.num + '” is a kit or drop-ship product. The order-create API rejects those, ' +
              'and this screen has no fallback route — enter it in the Sales Order module instead.', 'error');
        return null;
    }
    const line = makeSaleLine(product, 1);
    insertLine(line, afterLineId);
    renderGrid();
    await priceLine(line, /*applyDefault*/ true);
    refreshLineCells(line); refreshTotals();
    return line;
}

// Load a line's candidates and settle on a price. `applyDefault` is only true
// for a brand-new line — re-pricing after a qty change must never overwrite a
// rule the operator chose.
async function priceLine(line, applyDefault) {
    if (!line || line.kind !== 'sale' || !line.product) return;
    const key = bpKey(line.product.id, line.qty, _customer ? _customer.id : 0);
    if (line.choicesKey === key && line.choices) { settleLinePrice(line, applyDefault); return; }

    line.choicesState = 'loading';
    refreshLineCells(line);
    let cand;
    try { cand = await candidatesForLine(line); }
    catch (e) { dbg('candidate load failed: ' + (e && e.message || e), 'error'); cand = { inScope: [], offList: [], source: 'none' }; }
    line.choices = cand; line.choicesKey = key; line.choicesState = 'ready';
    settleLinePrice(line, applyDefault);
    refreshLineCells(line);
}

function allCandidates(line) {
    if (!line.choices) return [];
    return line.choices.inScope.concat(line.choices.offList);
}

function settleLinePrice(line, applyDefault) {
    if (line.priceSource === 'manual') return;

    // "None" was chosen deliberately: hold the product's list price and record
    // nothing, whatever the rules would otherwise do here.
    if (line.ruleCleared) {
        line.ruleId = null; line.ruleName = '';
        line.ruleNotApplicable = null; line.autoWould = null;
        line.unitPrice = line.product.price;
        line.priceSource = 'product';
        return;
    }

    // Recomputed every time, so a qty change that brings the customer's
    // default rule back into its bracket clears the "n/a" mark instead of
    // leaving a stale warning on the row.
    line.ruleNotApplicable = null;
    line.autoWould = null;

    // A rule already chosen keeps its identity; only its price is refreshed
    // (the qty may have crossed a break).
    if (line.ruleId != null) {
        const c = allCandidates(line).find(x => x.id === line.ruleId);
        if (c && c.unitPrice != null) { line.unitPrice = c.unitPrice; line.ruleName = c.name; return; }
        // Still selected, but no longer priceable at this qty/product.
        line.unitPrice = line.product.price;
        line.priceSource = 'product';
        return;
    }

    if (applyDefault && _defaultRules.length && pref('defaultRuleApplyToNewLines') && !line.ruleLocked) {
        // The note says which rules are IN PLAY for this customer, not which
        // one fits a given product — "PROF 15% & SVC 20%" means try the
        // professional rule and the service rule. So each is tested against
        // its OWN product scope and quantity bracket, in the order the note
        // listed them, and the first that applies AND can be priced wins.
        const q = line.qty > 0 ? line.qty : 1;
        for (const d of _defaultRules) {
            const r = d.rule;
            if (!productMatchesRule(line.product, r) || !qtyMatchesRule(q, r)) continue;
            const c = allCandidates(line).find(x => x.id === intOf(r.id));
            if (!c || c.unitPrice == null) continue;
            line.ruleId = c.id; line.ruleName = c.name; line.unitPrice = c.unitPrice;
            line.ruleAuto = true;
            line.priceSource = c.source === 'server' ? 'rule' : 'rule-local';
            return;
        }
        // None of them covers this product. Say so on the row rather than
        // substituting something else in silence.
        line.ruleNotApplicable = _defaultRules.map(d => d.rule.name).join(', ');
    }

    // Nothing came from the customer's note, so fall to Fishbowl's own
    // auto-apply rules. The price is read back out of the candidate list so it
    // is the SERVER's figure wherever the server answered.
    if (applyDefault) {
        const w = autoApplyWinner(line.product, line.qty);
        if (w) {
            const c = allCandidates(line).find(x => x.id === intOf(w.id));
            if (c && c.unitPrice != null) {
                line.ruleId = c.id; line.ruleName = c.name; line.unitPrice = c.unitPrice;
                line.ruleAuto = true;
                line.priceSource = c.source === 'server' ? 'rule' : 'rule-local';
                return;
            }
        }
    }

    // Nothing chosen — show what Fishbowl would do on its own.
    const auto = (line.choices ? line.choices.inScope : []).find(c => c.valid);
    if (auto && auto.unitPrice != null) {
        line.unitPrice = auto.unitPrice;
        line.priceSource = auto.source === 'server' ? 'rule' : 'rule-local';
        line.ruleId = null; line.ruleName = '';
        line.autoWould = auto.name;
    } else {
        line.unitPrice = line.product.price;
        line.priceSource = 'product';
        line.autoWould = null;
    }
}

function setLineQty(line, qty) {
    const q = numOf(qty);
    line.qty = (q == null || q < 0) ? 0 : q;
    refreshLineCells(line); refreshTotals();
    clearTimeout(line._qtyT);
    // Debounced — a qty change re-asks the server for candidates, and a round
    // trip per keystroke would be unusable.
    line._qtyT = setTimeout(async () => {
        await priceLine(line, /*applyDefault*/ false);
        refreshLineCells(line); refreshTotals();
    }, 300);
}

function setLineManualPrice(line, price) {
    const p = numOf(price);
    if (p == null) return;
    line.unitPrice = roundCents(p);
    line.priceSource = 'manual';
    line.ruleLocked = true;
    line.ruleCleared = false;
    // A hand-typed price is not the outcome of a rule. Recording the rule
    // anyway would attribute a number to a reason that didn't produce it.
    const sentinel = String(pref('manualOverrideCfValue') || '');
    line.ruleId = null;
    line.ruleName = sentinel;
    line.ruleAuto = false;
    refreshLineCells(line); refreshTotals();
}

async function repriceAllLines() {
    const sale = _lines.filter(l => l.kind === 'sale' && l.product);
    if (!sale.length) return;
    setStatusLine('Re-pricing ' + sale.length + ' line' + (sale.length === 1 ? '' : 's') + '…');
    // Cap concurrency — a customer change re-asks for every line at once and
    // an unbounded fan-out stalls the bridge.
    const queue = sale.slice();
    const workers = new Array(Math.min(4, queue.length)).fill(0).map(async () => {
        while (queue.length) {
            const l = queue.shift();
            l.choicesKey = '';                       // customer changed → cache is stale
            await priceLine(l, /*applyDefault*/ !l.ruleLocked);
        }
    });
    await Promise.all(workers);
    renderGrid(); refreshTotals();
    setStatusLine(statusText());
}

// ============================================================================
//  COLUMN MODEL
// ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
//  Columns are draggable to reorder and draggable to resize, so neither the
//  order nor the widths can live in the stylesheet — applyGridTemplate()
//  writes the track list from this model, and it persists per user.
//
//  Three columns are PINNED and take no part in either: the drag grip and the
//  line number on the left, and the remove button on the right. Moving those
//  would only break the row's shape, and the Note row and the blank entry row
//  both span "everything between them" (grid-column: 3 / -3), which is what
//  lets those two rows survive any rearrangement of the middle.
// ============================================================================
const COL_DEFS = [
    { key: 'drag',    label: '',              w: 22,  min: 22,  pin: 'first', ctr: true },
    { key: 'no',      label: '#',             w: 32,  min: 28,  pin: 'first', num: true },
    // `req` columns cannot be hidden — without them the row cannot describe
    // an order line at all.
    { key: 'num',      label: 'Number',        w: 120, min: 70, req: true },
    { key: 'desc',     label: 'Description',   w: 190, min: 80 },
    { key: 'qty',      label: 'Qty',           w: 74,  min: 50, num: true, req: true },
    { key: 'uom',      label: 'UOM',           w: 52,  min: 40, ctr: true },
    { key: 'rule',     label: 'Pricing Rule',  w: 200, min: 90, req: true },
    // What will actually be written to the order-item custom field. Usually
    // the same text as the Pricing Rule cell, but NOT always — a hand-typed
    // price records nothing (or a sentinel), and a rule Fishbowl merely WOULD
    // have applied is shown but not recorded. This column is the honest
    // answer to "is the capture working?".
    { key: 'rulecf',   label: 'Rule recorded', w: 180, min: 80 },
    { key: 'list',     label: 'List',          w: 106, min: 60, num: true },
    { key: 'price',    label: 'Unit Price',    w: 112, min: 64, num: true, req: true },
    { key: 'disc',     label: 'Disc',          w: 74,  min: 48, num: true },
    { key: 'taxcode',  label: 'Tax Code',      w: 88,  min: 52, ctr: true },
    { key: 'tax',      label: 'Tax Amount',    w: 106, min: 60, num: true },
    { key: 'taxtotal', label: 'Tax Total',     w: 110, min: 60, num: true },
    { key: 'ext',      label: 'Total ex Tax',  w: 118, min: 60, num: true },
    { key: 'totinc',   label: 'Total inc Tax', w: 122, min: 70, num: true },
    { key: 'del',     label: '',              w: 30,  min: 30, pin: 'last', ctr: true },
];
const COL_BY_KEY = new Map(COL_DEFS.map(c => [c.key, c]));
const COL_TIPS = {
    list:    'List price on the product record',
    price:   'The price being charged. Shown in blue when it differs from list.',
    disc:    'Discount against the product’s list price',
    taxcode:  'The rate the server will apply to this line: the order rate, or None for a non-taxable product',
    tax:      'Tax on ONE unit at this line\u2019s rate',
    taxtotal: 'Tax on the whole line \u2014 quantity \u00d7 tax amount',
    ext:      'Quantity \u00d7 unit price, before tax',
    totinc:   'Total ex tax plus the line\u2019s tax',
    rulecf:   'The exact text this line will store in the order-item custom field',
};
const MIDDLE_KEYS = COL_DEFS.filter(c => !c.pin).map(c => c.key);

let _colOrder = MIDDLE_KEYS.slice();   // the rearrangeable middle, in display order
let _colW = {};                        // key -> px
let _colHidden = new Set();            // keys the user has switched off

function loadColPrefs() {
    let saved = null;
    try { saved = pref('gridCols'); } catch (_) {}
    if (!saved || typeof saved !== 'object') saved = {};
    // Keep any saved order, drop keys that no longer exist, and append columns
    // added since the preference was written — so a new column shows up instead
    // of silently vanishing for everyone who has saved a layout.
    const savedOrder = Array.isArray(saved.order) ? saved.order.filter(k => MIDDLE_KEYS.indexOf(k) >= 0) : [];
    _colOrder = savedOrder.concat(MIDDLE_KEYS.filter(k => savedOrder.indexOf(k) < 0));
    const w = (saved.widths && typeof saved.widths === 'object') ? saved.widths : {};
    _colW = {};
    COL_DEFS.forEach(c => {
        const v = intOf(w[c.key]);
        _colW[c.key] = (v != null && v >= c.min) ? Math.min(v, 600) : c.w;
    });
    // A required column can never end up hidden, however old the saved layout.
    _colHidden = new Set((Array.isArray(saved.hidden) ? saved.hidden : [])
        .filter(k => { const c = COL_BY_KEY.get(k); return c && !c.pin && !c.req; }));
}
function saveColPrefs() {
    try {
        FBLib.Settings.setUserKey('gridCols', {
            order: _colOrder.slice(), widths: Object.assign({}, _colW), hidden: [..._colHidden],
        });
        FBLib.Settings.saveUser();
    } catch (_) {}
}
function resetColPrefs() {
    _colOrder = MIDDLE_KEYS.slice();
    _colW = {};
    COL_DEFS.forEach(c => { _colW[c.key] = c.w; });
    _colHidden = new Set();
    saveColPrefs();
    renderGrid();
    renderColPicker();
}
// VISIBLE columns, in display order. Everything that paints a row iterates
// this, so hiding a column removes its cell everywhere at once.
function orderedKeys() {
    return COL_DEFS.filter(c => c.pin === 'first').map(c => c.key)
        .concat(_colOrder.filter(k => !_colHidden.has(k)))
        .concat(COL_DEFS.filter(c => c.pin === 'last').map(c => c.key));
}
function setColVisible(key, on) {
    const c = COL_BY_KEY.get(key);
    if (!c || c.pin || c.req) return;
    if (on) _colHidden.delete(key); else _colHidden.add(key);
    saveColPrefs();
    renderGrid();
    renderColPicker();
}
function applyGridTemplate() {
    const g = document.getElementById('soGrid');
    if (!g) return;
    const keys = orderedKeys();
    const total = keys.reduce((n, k) => n + _colW[k], 0);
    // The trailing spacer soaks up any width beyond the columns, so the grid
    // fills its container without stretching a data column.
    g.style.gridTemplateColumns = keys.map(k => _colW[k] + 'px').join(' ') + ' minmax(0,1fr)';
    g.style.minWidth = total + 'px';
}

function renderColPicker() {
    const box = document.getElementById('colList');
    if (!box) return;
    box.innerHTML = _colOrder.map(k => {
        const c = COL_BY_KEY.get(k);
        const on = !_colHidden.has(k);
        return '<label class="col-row' + (c.req ? ' req' : '') + '">' +
               '<input type="checkbox" data-colvis="' + k + '"' + (on ? ' checked' : '') +
               (c.req ? ' disabled' : '') + '>' +
               '<span>' + escHtml(colLabel(c) || k) + '</span>' +
               (c.req ? '<span class="col-req">always</span>' : '') +
               '</label>';
    }).join('');
    box.querySelectorAll('[data-colvis]').forEach(cb => {
        cb.addEventListener('change', () => setColVisible(cb.getAttribute('data-colvis'), cb.checked));
    });
    const btn = document.getElementById('colsBtn');
    if (btn) btn.classList.toggle('active', _colHidden.size > 0);
}

function toggleColPicker() {
    const pop = document.getElementById('colPop');
    if (pop.classList.contains('open')) { pop.classList.remove('open'); return; }
    const r = document.getElementById('colsBtn').getBoundingClientRect();
    pop.style.left = Math.round(Math.min(r.left, window.innerWidth - 252)) + 'px';
    pop.style.top = Math.round(r.bottom + 6) + 'px';
    renderColPicker();
    pop.classList.add('open');
}

                   escHtml(fmtMoney(p.price)) + '</span></div>';

                   '" type="text" inputmode="decimal" data-price="' + id +

        case 'disc':

    }
}

// A heading is aligned by its column, never by hand: a right-aligned number
// under a left-aligned heading is the classic way a grid stops being readable.
function alignClass(key) {
    const c = COL_BY_KEY.get(key);
    if (!c) return '';
    return c.num ? ' num' : (c.ctr ? ' ctr' : '');
}

// The "Rule recorded" heading names the custom field it writes to, and that
// field is configurable — so the label is resolved at render time rather than
// baked into COL_DEFS.
function colLabel(c) {
    if (!c) return '';
    if (c.key === 'rulecf') return String(pref('ruleCfName') || c.label);
    return c.label;
}

function headerHtml() {
    const out = orderedKeys().map(k => {

        return '<div class="hd' + alignClass(k) + (movable ? ' movable' : '') + '" data-col="' + k + '"' +
               (movable ? ' draggable="true"' : '') + tip + '>' +
               escHtml(colLabel(c)) +
               (c.pin === 'last' ? '' : '<span class="col-rz" data-rz="' + k + '"></span>') +
               '</div>';
    });
    out.push('<div class="hd"></div>');            // spacer track

}

function renderGrid() {

function ruleCellHtml(l) {

    } else if (l.ruleNotApplicable) {

// ── Per-line money ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
// `lineExt` is the line total EXCLUDING tax — qty x the price actually being
// charged. Everything else derives from it.
function taxCodeCellHtml(l) {
    const t = lineTaxRateRow(l);
    if (t) {
        const why = _taxMode === 'order'
            ? 'The order\u2019s tax rate'
            : 'The product\u2019s own tax code';
        return '<span class="taxcode" title="' + escHtml(t.name + ' \u2014 ' + why) + '">' +
               escHtml(t.code || t.name) + '</span>';
    }
    if (l.product && l.taxable === false) {
        return '<span class="taxcode none" title="This product is flagged non-taxable, so the line is booked at None.">None</span>';
    }
    if (_taxMode === 'product') {
        return '<span class="taxcode none" title="This product carries no tax code of its own, so the line is booked at None.">None</span>';
    }
    return '<span class="taxcode none" title="No order tax rate is selected.">None</span>';
}

// The literal custom-field value for this line, rendered as it will be
// stored. Nothing is shown as a muted "not recorded" rather than an empty
// cell: a blank reads as "nothing to see here", when what it actually means
// is that the reason for this price is about to be lost.
function ruleCfCellHtml(l) {
    const v = ruleValueFor(l);
    if (!v) return '<span class="cfval none" title="Nothing will be written to the custom field for this line.">not recorded</span>';
    return '<span class="cfval" title="' + escHtml(v) + '">' + escHtml(v) + '</span>';
}

function lineExt(l) { return l.kind === 'sale' ? roundCents((l.qty || 0) * (l.unitPrice || 0)) : 0; }

// What the line would have come to at the product's own list price. The
// discount column is the gap between this and lineExt.
function lineListExt(l) { return l.kind === 'sale' ? roundCents((l.qty || 0) * (l.product ? l.product.price : 0)) : 0; }

// The tax rate this line will actually be booked at.
//
//   * A non-taxable product is always None, whatever the order says — that is
//     the create endpoint's own rule.
//   * In 'order' mode the line inherits the order's rate.
//   * In 'product' mode (a customer with no rate of their own) the line takes
//     the PRODUCT's own tax code, so a mixed order taxes each line correctly
//     instead of flattening everything to one rate or to nothing.
//
// Derived, never typed: it is what the server will do, shown before it does it.
function lineTaxRateRow(l) {
    if (l.kind !== 'sale' || !l.taxable || !l.product) return null;
    if (_taxMode === 'order') return _taxRateId != null ? (_taxRateById.get(_taxRateId) || null) : null;
    const pid = l.product.taxRateId;
    if (pid == null || pid === NONE_TAX_ID) return null;
    return _taxRateById.get(pid) || null;
}

// The rate to put on the ORDER. In per-product mode there is no single answer,
// so the most common line rate is used and only the lines that differ carry an
// explicit override — which keeps the payload closest to what the server
// accepts without argument.
function resolveOrderTaxRateId(lines) {
    if (_taxMode === 'order' && _taxRateId != null) return _taxRateId;
    const counts = new Map();
    (lines || []).filter(l => l.kind === 'sale').forEach(l => {
        const t = lineTaxRateRow(l);
        const id = t ? t.id : NONE_TAX_ID;
        counts.set(id, (counts.get(id) || 0) + 1);
    });
    let best = NONE_TAX_ID, bestN = -1;
    counts.forEach((n, id) => { if (n > bestN) { bestN = n; best = id; } });
    return best;
}
function lineTaxCode(l) {
    const t = lineTaxRateRow(l);
    return t ? (t.code || t.name) : 'None';
}
// Tax on ONE unit, which is what the client's grid puts beside the unit
// price. Rounded per unit, so it reads as the money it is.
function lineTaxPerUnit(l) {
    const t = lineTaxRateRow(l);
    return t ? roundCents((l.unitPrice || 0) * (t.rate || 0)) : 0;
}
// Tax on the WHOLE line. Deliberately computed from the line total rather
// than per-unit tax x qty: rounding once at the end is what the order will
// actually be charged, and the two differ by cents at high quantities.
function lineTax(l) {
    const t = lineTaxRateRow(l);
    return t ? roundCents(lineExt(l) * (t.rate || 0)) : 0;
}
function lineTotalInc(l) { return roundCents(lineExt(l) + lineTax(l)); }

// Discount against the product's list price, as a percentage. Negative means
// the line is priced ABOVE list, which is worth seeing just as plainly.
function lineDiscountPct(l) {
    const list = l.product ? (l.product.price || 0) : 0;
    if (!list) return null;
    return (1 - (l.unitPrice || 0) / list) * 100;
}
function discCellHtml(l) {
    const d = lineDiscountPct(l);
    if (d == null) return '<span class="disc zero">—</span>';
    if (Math.abs(d) < 0.05) return '<span class="disc zero">—</span>';
    if (d >= 99.995) return '<span class="disc free">FREE</span>';
    const cls = d > 0 ? 'off' : 'up';
    const sign = d > 0 ? '−' : '+';   // minus sign, not a hyphen
    return '<span class="disc ' + cls + '">' + sign + Math.abs(d).toFixed(Math.abs(d) % 1 < 0.05 ? 0 : 1) + '%</span>';
}
// True once the line is no longer at the product's list price — drives the
// blue unit-price text.
function priceMoved(l) {
    return !!(l.product && Math.abs((l.unitPrice || 0) - (l.product.price || 0)) >= 0.005);
}

// Update only the cells whose value changed. A full re-render on every
// keystroke would steal focus out of the input being typed into.
function refreshLineCells(l) {
    const g = document.getElementById('soGrid');
    const cell = k => g.querySelector('[data-line="' + l.lineId + '"][data-cell="' + k + '"]');

    const rc = cell('rule');
    if (rc) { rc.innerHTML = ruleCellHtml(l); wireRuleButton(rc.querySelector('[data-rule]')); }

    const dc = cell('disc');     if (dc) dc.innerHTML = discCellHtml(l);
    const tc = cell('taxcode');  if (tc) tc.innerHTML = taxCodeCellHtml(l);
    const fc = cell('rulecf');   if (fc) fc.innerHTML = ruleCfCellHtml(l);

    const money = (k, v) => { const e = cell(k); if (e) { const sp = e.querySelector('.cell-ro'); if (sp) sp.textContent = fmtMoney(v); } };
    money('tax', lineTaxPerUnit(l));
    money('taxtotal', lineTax(l));
    money('ext', lineExt(l));
    money('totinc', lineTotalInc(l));

    const pi = g.querySelector('[data-price="' + l.lineId + '"]');
    if (pi) {
        // Don't fight the operator's cursor — only rewrite the value when the
        // field isn't the one being typed into.
        if (document.activeElement !== pi) pi.value = (l.unitPrice != null ? l.unitPrice : 0).toFixed(2);
        pi.classList.toggle('moved', priceMoved(l));
    }
}

// Every line's tax cells depend on the ORDER rate, so changing it has to
// repaint all of them, not just the totals bar.
function refreshAllLineCells() {
    _lines.filter(l => l.kind === 'sale').forEach(refreshLineCells);
}

function refreshTotals() {
    const sale = _lines.filter(l => l.kind === 'sale');

        : 'No lines';

function canSave() {

function statusText() {
    if (!_customer) return 'Select a customer to begin.';

function wireGrid() {
    const g = document.getElementById('soGrid');

    // Row hover — display:contents leaves no row element to hang :hover on.
    g.querySelectorAll('[data-line]').forEach(cell => {
        cell.addEventListener('mouseenter', () => setRowHover(cell.getAttribute('data-line'), true));
        cell.addEventListener('mouseleave', () => setRowHover(cell.getAttribute('data-line'), false));
    });

    g.querySelectorAll('[data-qty]').forEach(inp => {
        const l = lineById(inp.getAttribute('data-qty'));
        inp.addEventListener('input', () => setLineQty(l, inp.value));
        inp.addEventListener('keydown', e => onCellKey(e, l, 'qty'));
    });

    g.querySelectorAll('[data-price]').forEach(inp => {
        const l = lineById(inp.getAttribute('data-price'));
        inp.addEventListener('change', () => setLineManualPrice(l, inp.value));
        inp.addEventListener('keydown', e => onCellKey(e, l, 'price'));
    });

    g.querySelectorAll('[data-rule]').forEach(wireRuleButton);

    g.querySelectorAll('[data-del]').forEach(b => {
        b.addEventListener('click', () => removeLine(b.getAttribute('data-del')));
    });

    g.querySelectorAll('[data-note]').forEach(ta => {
        const l = lineById(ta.getAttribute('data-note'));
        autoGrow(ta);
        ta.addEventListener('input', () => { l.text = ta.value; autoGrow(ta); });
        // An empty note that loses focus deletes itself — no orphan blank rows.
        ta.addEventListener('blur', () => { if (!ta.value.trim()) removeLine(l.lineId); });
        ta.addEventListener('keydown', e => onCellKey(e, l, 'note'));
    });

    g.querySelectorAll('.gap').forEach(gap => {
        const after = gap.getAttribute('data-gap');
        const btn = gap.querySelector('.gap-btn');
        btn.addEventListener('click', e => {
            e.stopPropagation();
            // Shift-click inserts a note outright — the shortcut worth learning.
            if (e.shiftKey) { addNoteAfter(after); return; }
            openInsertMenu(btn, after);
        });
        gap.addEventListener('dragover', e => { e.preventDefault(); gap.classList.add('act'); });
        gap.addEventListener('dragleave', () => gap.classList.remove('act'));
        gap.addEventListener('drop', e => {
            e.preventDefault(); gap.classList.remove('act');
            const dragged = e.dataTransfer.getData('text/plain');
            if (!dragged) return;
            // Dropping on the band after line X means "sit directly after X".
            const idx = after === '' ? 0 : lineIndex(after) + 1;
            const target = _lines[idx] && _lines[idx].lineId !== dragged ? _lines[idx].lineId : null;
            moveLine(dragged, target);
        });
    });

    g.querySelectorAll('[data-drag]').forEach(h => {
        h.addEventListener('dragstart', e => {
            _dragLineId = h.getAttribute('data-drag');
            e.dataTransfer.setData('text/plain', _dragLineId);
            e.dataTransfer.effectAllowed = 'move';
            markRow(_dragLineId, 'row-dragging', true);
        });
        h.addEventListener('dragend', () => {
            markRow(_dragLineId, 'row-dragging', false);
            clearRowDropMarks();
            _dragLineId = null;
        });
    });

    wireRowDrop(g);
    wireHeader(g);

    const np = document.getElementById('newProduct');
    if (np) wireProductTypeahead(np);
}

// ── ROW REORDER ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Dropping on the 7px band between rows is precise but fiddly, so the ROWS
// themselves are drop targets too: the top half of a row means "above it",
// the bottom half "below it", with a line drawn on the edge you would land on.
let _dragLineId = null;

function markRow(lineId, cls, on) {
    if (!lineId) return;
    document.querySelectorAll('#soGrid [data-line="' + lineId + '"]')
        .forEach(c => c.classList.toggle(cls, !!on));
}
function clearRowDropMarks() {
    document.querySelectorAll('#soGrid .drop-before, #soGrid .drop-after')
        .forEach(c => c.classList.remove('drop-before', 'drop-after'));
}

function wireRowDrop(g) {
    g.querySelectorAll('[data-line]').forEach(cell => {
        const targetId = cell.getAttribute('data-line');
        cell.addEventListener('dragover', e => {
            if (!_dragLineId || _dragLineId === targetId) return;
            e.preventDefault();
            e.dataTransfer.dropEffect = 'move';
            const r = cell.getBoundingClientRect();
            const after = (e.clientY - r.top) > r.height / 2;
            clearRowDropMarks();
            markRow(targetId, after ? 'drop-after' : 'drop-before', true);
        });
        cell.addEventListener('drop', e => {
            if (!_dragLineId || _dragLineId === targetId) return;
            e.preventDefault();
            e.stopPropagation();
            const r = cell.getBoundingClientRect();
            const after = (e.clientY - r.top) > r.height / 2;
            const dragged = _dragLineId;
            clearRowDropMarks();
            _dragLineId = null;
            moveLineRelative(dragged, targetId, after);
        });
    });
}

// Resolve "put the dragged line above/below this one" into the single
// before-id that moveLine() takes. The target index is computed with the
// dragged line already removed, or dropping downwards lands one row short.
function moveLineRelative(draggedId, targetId, after) {
    if (!draggedId || draggedId === targetId) return;
    const rest = _lines.filter(l => l.lineId !== draggedId);
    const ti = rest.findIndex(l => l.lineId === targetId);
    if (ti < 0) return;
    const beforeId = after ? (rest[ti + 1] ? rest[ti + 1].lineId : null) : targetId;
    moveLine(draggedId, beforeId);
}

// ── COLUMN RESIZE + REORDER ──────────────────────────────────────────
let _dragColKey = null;

function wireHeader(g) {
    // Resize: drag the grip on a header's right edge. Widths are applied live
    // and only persisted on release, so a drag costs one settings write.
    g.querySelectorAll('[data-rz]').forEach(grip => {
        grip.addEventListener('mousedown', e => {
            e.preventDefault();
            e.stopPropagation();
            const key = grip.getAttribute('data-rz');
            const def = COL_BY_KEY.get(key);
            const startX = e.clientX, startW = _colW[key];
            grip.classList.add('active');
            document.body.classList.add('col-resizing');
            const onMove = ev => {
                _colW[key] = Math.max(def.min, Math.min(600, startW + (ev.clientX - startX)));
                applyGridTemplate();
            };
            const onUp = () => {
                document.removeEventListener('mousemove', onMove);
                document.removeEventListener('mouseup', onUp);
                grip.classList.remove('active');
                document.body.classList.remove('col-resizing');
                saveColPrefs();
            };
            document.addEventListener('mousemove', onMove);
            document.addEventListener('mouseup', onUp);
        });
        // The grip sits inside a draggable header; without this a resize
        // gesture starts a column drag instead.
        grip.addEventListener('dragstart', e => { e.preventDefault(); e.stopPropagation(); });
    });

    g.querySelectorAll('.hd.movable').forEach(hd => {
        const key = hd.getAttribute('data-col');
        hd.addEventListener('dragstart', e => {
            _dragColKey = key;
            e.dataTransfer.setData('text/plain', 'col:' + key);
            e.dataTransfer.effectAllowed = 'move';
            hd.classList.add('dragging');
        });
        hd.addEventListener('dragend', () => {
            hd.classList.remove('dragging');
            clearColDropMarks();
            _dragColKey = null;
        });
        hd.addEventListener('dragover', e => {
            if (!_dragColKey || _dragColKey === key) return;
            e.preventDefault();
            e.dataTransfer.dropEffect = 'move';
            const r = hd.getBoundingClientRect();
            const after = (e.clientX - r.left) > r.width / 2;
            clearColDropMarks();
            hd.classList.add(after ? 'col-drag-over-r' : 'col-drag-over');
        });
        hd.addEventListener('drop', e => {
            if (!_dragColKey || _dragColKey === key) return;
            e.preventDefault();
            const r = hd.getBoundingClientRect();
            const after = (e.clientX - r.left) > r.width / 2;
            const moved = _dragColKey;
            clearColDropMarks();
            _dragColKey = null;
            moveColumn(moved, key, after);
        });
    });
}

function clearColDropMarks() {
    document.querySelectorAll('#soGrid .hd').forEach(h => h.classList.remove('col-drag-over', 'col-drag-over-r'));
}

function moveColumn(dragKey, targetKey, after) {
    if (dragKey === targetKey) return;
    // Only the rearrangeable middle takes part. Without this guard a pinned
    // key spliced into _colOrder and the column appeared twice.
    if (MIDDLE_KEYS.indexOf(dragKey) < 0 || MIDDLE_KEYS.indexOf(targetKey) < 0) return;
    const rest = _colOrder.filter(k => k !== dragKey);
    const ti = rest.indexOf(targetKey);
    if (ti < 0) return;
    rest.splice(after ? ti + 1 : ti, 0, dragKey);
    _colOrder = rest;
    saveColPrefs();
    renderGrid();
}

function setRowHover(lineId, on) {
    document.querySelectorAll('#soGrid [data-line="' + lineId + '"]').forEach(c => c.classList.toggle('hov', on));
}

function autoGrow(ta) {
    ta.style.height = 'auto';
    ta.style.height = Math.min(ta.scrollHeight, 130) + 'px';
    ta.style.overflowY = ta.scrollHeight > 130 ? 'auto' : 'hidden';
}

function addNoteAfter(afterLineId) {
    const l = insertLine(makeNoteLine(''), afterLineId);
    renderGrid(); refreshTotals();
    const ta = document.querySelector('[data-note="' + l.lineId + '"]');
    if (ta) ta.focus();
}
function addNoteBefore(beforeLineId) {
    const l = insertLineBefore(makeNoteLine(''), beforeLineId);
    renderGrid(); refreshTotals();

// ============================================================================
let _taMatches = [], _taHl = -1, _taInput = null;

function wireProductTypeahead(input) {
    _taInput = input;
    input.addEventListener('input', () => showTypeahead(input.value));
    // Opens on focus with the whole catalogue, not only once something has
    // been typed — clicking the cell should show what is available.
    input.addEventListener('focus', () => showTypeahead(input.value));
    input.addEventListener('mousedown', () => setTimeout(() => showTypeahead(input.value), 0));
    input.addEventListener('blur', () => setTimeout(closeTypeahead, 180));
    input.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
        const pop = document.getElementById('taPop');
        if (!pop.classList.contains('open')) return;
        if (e.key === 'ArrowDown') { e.preventDefault(); if (_taHl < _taMatches.length - 1) { _taHl++; hlTypeahead(); } }
        else if (e.key === 'ArrowUp') { e.preventDefault(); if (_taHl > 0) { _taHl--; hlTypeahead(); } }
        else if (e.key === 'Enter') {
            e.preventDefault();
            const pick = _taMatches[_taHl >= 0 ? _taHl : 0];
            if (pick) chooseProduct(pick);
        }
        else if (e.key === 'Escape') { closeTypeahead(); }
    });
}

const TA_LIMIT = 100;
function showTypeahead(term) {
    const q = String(term || '').trim().toLowerCase();
    const pop = document.getElementById('taPop'), list = document.getElementById('taList');
    if (!_products.length) { closeTypeahead(); return; }
    // No search term lists the catalogue from the top rather than showing
    // nothing — the cell is a browser as well as a search box.
    const all = q ? _products.filter(p => p.search.includes(q)) : _products;
    _taMatches = all.slice(0, TA_LIMIT);
    _taHl = _taMatches.length ? 0 : -1;
    const more = all.length - _taMatches.length;
    list.innerHTML = _taMatches.length
        ? _taMatches.map((p, i) =>
            '<div class="ta-item' + (i === 0 ? ' hl' : '') + '" data-pid="' + p.id + '">' +
            '<span class="pn">' + escHtml(p.num) + '</span>' +
            '<span class="pd">' + escHtml(p.description) + '</span>' +
            '<span class="pp">' + escHtml(fmtMoney(p.price)) + '</span></div>').join('') +
            (more > 0 ? '<div class="ta-empty">' + more.toLocaleString() + ' more \u2014 keep typing to narrow</div>' : '')
        : '<div class="ta-empty">No matching product</div>';
    const r = _taInput.getBoundingClientRect();
    pop.style.left = Math.round(r.left) + 'px';
    pop.style.top = Math.round(r.bottom + 3) + 'px';
    pop.style.width = Math.max(360, Math.round(r.width)) + 'px';
    pop.classList.add('open');
    list.querySelectorAll('[data-pid]').forEach(it => {
        it.addEventListener('mousedown', e => {
            e.preventDefault();
            const p = _productById.get(intOf(it.getAttribute('data-pid')));
            if (p) chooseProduct(p);
        });
    });
}
function hlTypeahead() {
    const items = document.querySelectorAll('#taList .ta-item');
    items.forEach((it, i) => { it.classList.toggle('hl', i === _taHl); if (i === _taHl) it.scrollIntoView({ block: 'nearest' }); });
}
function closeTypeahead() { document.getElementById('taPop').classList.remove('open'); _taHl = -1; }

async function chooseProduct(product) {

function renderRuleList() {
    const l = _pickLine;
    const box = document.getElementById('ruleList');
    if (!l) { box.innerHTML = ''; return; }
    const f = _ruleFilter.trim().toLowerCase();
    const match = c => !f || (c.name + ' ' + (c.description || '')).toLowerCase().includes(f);

    const inScope = (l.choices ? l.choices.inScope : []).filter(match);
    const offList = (l.choices ? l.choices.offList : []).filter(match);
    const valid = inScope.filter(c => c.valid).sort(byPrice);
    const other = inScope.filter(c => !c.valid).sort(byPrice);

    const html = [];
    // None leads the list, so clearing a rule is a choice among the rules
    // rather than a link the operator has to notice at the bottom.
    if (!f) {
        html.push('<div class="rule-item' + (l.ruleCleared ? ' sel' : '') + '" data-rid="none">' +
            '<div class="ri-main"><div class="ri-nm">None</div>' +
            '<div class="ri-sub">No rule — charge the list price, record nothing</div></div>' +
            '<div class="ri-px">' + escHtml(fmtMoney(l.product ? l.product.price : 0)) + '</div></div>');
    }
    if (valid.length) { html.push('<div class="rule-grp">Fishbowl would apply</div>'); valid.forEach(c => html.push(itemHtml(c, l))); }
    if (other.length) { html.push('<div class="rule-grp">Other rules in scope</div>'); other.forEach(c => html.push(itemHtml(c, l))); }
    // EVERY active rule is listed, always. Hiding the out-of-scope ones behind
    // a toggle is what makes the operator hunt: the rules applied by hand here
    // — a sample or BDF rule on a retail line — are precisely the ones
    // Fishbowl would never offer on its own.
    if (offList.length) {
        html.push('<div class="rule-grp">All other active rules — applied by hand</div>');
        offList.forEach(c => html.push(itemHtml(c, l)));
    }
    if (!html.length) html.push('<div class="ta-empty">' + (f ? 'No rule matches “' + escHtml(_ruleFilter) + '”' : 'No active pricing rules') + '</div>');
    box.innerHTML = html.join('');
    const cnt = document.getElementById('ruleCount');
    if (cnt) {
        const shown = valid.length + other.length + offList.length;
        cnt.textContent = shown + ' of ' + _allRulesById.size + ' rule' + (_allRulesById.size === 1 ? '' : 's');
    }
    box.querySelectorAll('[data-rid]').forEach(it => {
        if (it.classList.contains('dis')) return;
        const rid = it.getAttribute('data-rid');
        it.addEventListener('click', () => pickRule(rid === 'none' ? null : intOf(rid)));
    });
}
function byPrice(a, b) { return (a.unitPrice == null ? 1e15 : a.unitPrice) - (b.unitPrice == null ? 1e15 : b.unitPrice); }

function itemHtml(c, l) {
    const rule = _allRulesById.get(c.id);
    let label = rule ? describeRule(rule) : (c.description || '');
    // Answers "why did that one attach itself?" without leaving the picker.
    if (rule && bitTrue(rule.isautoapply)) label += '  ·  applies automatically';
    const sel = l.ruleId === c.id;
    if (c.unitPrice == null) {
        return '<div class="rule-item dis" title="' + escHtml(c.blocked || '') + '">' +
               '<div class="ri-main"><div class="ri-nm">' + escHtml(c.name) + '</div>' +
               '<div class="ri-sub">' + escHtml(c.blocked || label) + '</div></div>' +
               '<div class="ri-px">—</div></div>';
    }
    const list = l.product.price || 0;
    let delta = '';
    if (c.unitPrice === 0) delta = '<div class="ri-dl">FREE</div>';
    else if (list > 0 && c.unitPrice < list) delta = '<div class="ri-dl">−' + Math.round((1 - c.unitPrice / list) * 100) + '%</div>';
    return '<div class="rule-item' + (sel ? ' sel' : '') + '" data-rid="' + c.id + '">' +
           '<div class="ri-main"><div class="ri-nm">' + escHtml(c.name) +
           (c.source === 'offlist' ? ' <span class="chip off">off-list</span>' : '') + '</div>' +
           '<div class="ri-sub">' + escHtml(label) + '</div></div>' +
           '<div class="ri-px">' + escHtml(fmtMoney(c.unitPrice)) + delta + '</div></div>';
}

function pickRule(ruleId) {

// ============================================================================
function addrForRest(a) {
    if (!a) return null;
    return {
        name: a.recipient || (_customer ? _customer.name : ''),
        street: a.street || '', city: a.city || '', state: a.state || '',
        postalCode: a.zip || '', country: a.countryAbbrev || a.country || '',
    };
}

function submittableLines() {
    return _lines.filter(l => (l.kind === 'sale' && l.qty > 0 && l.product) ||
                              (l.kind === 'note' && String(l.text || '').trim()));
}

function buildPayload() {
    const ship = _addresses.find(a => a.id === intOf(document.getElementById('fShipTo').value));
    const bill = _addresses.find(a => a.id === intOf(document.getElementById('fBillTo').value));
    const lgId = intOf(document.getElementById('fLocationGroup').value);
    const po = document.getElementById('fCustomerPO').value.trim();
    const vpo = document.getElementById('fVendorPO').value.trim();
    const note = document.getElementById('fNote').value.trim();
    const sched = document.getElementById('fScheduled').value;

    const lines = submittableLines();
    // Always explicit: omitting the order rate resolves it to the system
    // default, which is None, and zero-rates everything.
    const orderTaxId = resolveOrderTaxRateId(lines);

    const body = {
        status: _statusId === 20 ? 'Issued' : 'Estimate',
        customer: { id: _customer.id },
        customerContact: (ship && ship.recipient) || _customer.name,
        taxRate: { id: orderTaxId },
        soItems: lines.map((l, i) => {
            if (l.kind === 'note') {
                return { type: { name: 'Note' }, product: { description: String(l.text).trim() }, lineNumber: i + 1 };
            }
            const item = {
                product: { id: l.product.id },
                type: { id: SOITEM_TYPE_SALE },
                lineNumber: i + 1,
                // Strings, matching the documented example — these are decimals
                // and JSON numbers risk float noise on the wire.
                quantity: String(l.qty),
                unitPrice: String(l.unitPrice != null ? l.unitPrice : l.product.price),
            };
            // A line only carries its own rate when it actually differs from
            // the order's. Sending a matching one is noise, and on a US
            // database a DIFFERING line rate is rejected outright unless it is
            // None — which is why the order rate above is chosen to be the one
            // most lines already want.
            const lt = lineTaxRateRow(l);
            const ltId = lt ? lt.id : NONE_TAX_ID;
            if (ltId !== orderTaxId) item.taxRate = { id: ltId };

            // Absence is the one representation of "no rule". Writing an empty
            // string reads back differently and muddies the report's bucket.
            const v = ruleValueFor(l);
            if (v) item.customFields = [{ id: _ruleCfId, value: v }];
            return item;
        }),
    };
    if (ship) body.shipToAddress = addrForRest(ship);
    if (bill) body.billToAddress = addrForRest(bill);
    // Setting a number needs SO_EDIT_SO_NUM; blank lets Fishbowl assign one.
    const soNum = document.getElementById('fSoNum').value.trim();
    if (soNum) body.number = soNum;
    const spId = intOf(document.getElementById('fSalesperson').value);
    if (spId != null) body.salesperson = { id: spId };
    if (_customer.carrierId) body.carrier = { id: _customer.carrierId };
    if (lgId) body.locationGroup = { id: lgId };
    if (po) body.customerPoNumber = po;
    if (vpo) body.vendorPoNumber = vpo;
    if (note) body.note = note;
    if (sched) body.dateScheduled = sched;
    return body;
}

function ruleValueFor(l) {
    if (l.kind !== 'sale') return '';
    if (l.priceSource === 'manual') return String(pref('manualOverrideCfValue') || '');
    return l.ruleId != null ? String(l.ruleName || '') : '';
}

function restErrStatus(err) {
    if (!err) return 0;
    const n = parseInt(err.status, 10);
    if (!isNaN(n)) return n;
    const m = String(err.message || err);
    if (/\b403\b|forbidden/i.test(m)) return 403;
    if (/\b405\b|method not allowed/i.test(m)) return 405;
    if (/\b404\b|not found/i.test(m)) return 404;
    if (/\b422\b/.test(m)) return 422;
    return 0;
}

async function saveOrder() {
    if (_submitting) return;
    _submitting = true; refreshSaveButton();
    setStatusLine('Creating the order…');

    const body = buildPayload();
    dbg('POST /api/sales-orders ' + JSON.stringify(body));

    let resp;
    try {
        resp = await postSalesOrder(body);
    } catch (err) {
        _submitting = false; refreshSaveButton();
        const st = restErrStatus(err);
        const msg = String(err && err.message || err);
        let hint = '';
        if (st === 403 && /price|override/i.test(msg)) {
            hint = ' This screen sets each line\'s price, which needs the SO_PRICE_OVERRIDE access right.';
        } else if (st === 403 && /number/i.test(msg)) {
            hint = ' Typing an SO number needs the SO_EDIT_SO_NUM access right \u2014 clear the SO No field ' +
                   'to let Fishbowl assign one.';
        } else if (st === 403) {
            hint = ' The signed-in user lacks a right this order needs.';
        } else if (st === 400 && /tax/i.test(msg)) {
            hint = ' A line\'s tax rate differs from the order\'s, which some databases reject outright. ' +
                   'Pick a single order tax rate instead of "Per product".';
        } else if (st === 422) {
            hint = ' The server rejected a line — kits and drop-ship products are not supported here.';
        } else if (st === 404 || st === 405) {
            hint = ' This server build does not expose the order-create endpoint.';
        }
        // Never auto-retry: a failure after the server accepted the write would
        // create a second order.
        setStatusLine('The order was NOT created.');
        toast('Order not created — ' + msg + hint + ' Check the Sales Order module before retrying, in case it was created anyway.', 'error', 20000);
        dbg('create failed: ' + msg, 'error');
        return;
    }

    const created = extractCreatedSo(resp);
    dbg('created: ' + JSON.stringify(created));
    await verifyCreated(created, body);

    _submitting = false;
    _lines = []; _lineSeq = 0;
    document.getElementById('fSoNum').value = '';
    fetchNextSoNumber(false);
    renderGrid(); refreshTotals();
    setStatusLine(created.num ? 'Created ' + created.num + '.' : 'Order created.');
    toast('Created ' + (created.num || 'the order') + '.', 'success', 8000);
    if (created.num && typeof openModule === 'function') {
        const n = created.num;
        toast('Open ' + n + ' in the Sales Order module?', 'info', 9000);
        // The offer is a toast rather than a jump: the operator often wants to
        // start the next order, not leave the screen.
        const box = document.getElementById('toastBox');
        const last = box.lastElementChild;
        if (last) {
            last.querySelector('.toast-msg').innerHTML =
                'Created <b>' + escHtml(n) + '</b> — <span style="color:var(--link);cursor:pointer;text-decoration:underline;" id="openSoLink">open it</span>';
            const lnk = last.querySelector('#openSoLink');
            if (lnk) lnk.addEventListener('click', () => { try { openModule('Sales Order', n); } catch (_) {} });
        }
    }
}

// One retry, and only for the salesperson: crediting someone else needs
// SO_EDIT_SALESPERSON, and an order booked to the signed-in user is far
// better than no order. Everything else is reported, never retried — a retry
// after the server has already accepted the write creates a second order.
async function postSalesOrder(body) {
    try {
        return await runRestApiAsync({
            method: 'POST', path: '/api/sales-orders',
            body: JSON.stringify(body), contentType: 'application/json',
        });
    } catch (err) {
        if (restErrStatus(err) === 403 && body.salesperson && /salesperson/i.test(String(err && err.message || ''))) {
            dbg('salesperson override refused (needs SO_EDIT_SALESPERSON) \u2014 retrying credited to the signed-in user', 'warn');
            const retry = Object.assign({}, body);
            delete retry.salesperson;
            const out = await runRestApiAsync({
                method: 'POST', path: '/api/sales-orders',
                body: JSON.stringify(retry), contentType: 'application/json',
            });
            toast('The order was credited to you: changing the salesperson needs the SO_EDIT_SALESPERSON right.', 'warn', 12000);
            return out;
        }
        throw err;
    }
}

function extractCreatedSo(resp) {
    const o = (typeof resp === 'string' ? safeParse(resp) : resp) || {};
    const so = o.salesOrder || o.data || o;
    const num = so.number != null ? so.number : (so.num != null ? so.num : (so.soNumber != null ? so.soNumber : null));
    return { id: intOf(so.id), num: num != null ? String(num) : null };
}
function safeParse(s) { try { return JSON.parse(s); } catch (_) { return null; } }

// Read the order back and compare it to what was sent. A custom field that
// silently didn't land would be invisible until the reporting screen came up
// empty months later.
async function verifyCreated(created, sent) {
    if (created.id == null) return;
    try {
        const got = await runRestApiAsync({ method: 'GET', path: '/api/sales-orders/' + created.id });
        const items = (got && (got.soItems || got.soitems)) || [];
        const problems = [];
        const sentSale = sent.soItems.filter(i => i.customFields);
        sentSale.forEach(si => {
            const match = items.find(x => intOf(x.lineNumber) === intOf(si.lineNumber));
            if (!match) { problems.push('line ' + si.lineNumber + ' is missing'); return; }
            const want = si.customFields[0].value;
            const cfs = match.customFields || [];
            const hit = cfs.find(c => intOf(c.id) === _ruleCfId);
            if (!hit || String(hit.value || '') !== want) {
                problems.push('line ' + si.lineNumber + ' did not keep its pricing rule (“' + want + '”)');
            }
            if (Math.abs((numOf(match.unitPrice) || 0) - (numOf(si.unitPrice) || 0)) >= 0.005) {
                problems.push('line ' + si.lineNumber + ' price came back as ' + fmtMoney(match.unitPrice) + ', not ' + fmtMoney(si.unitPrice));
            }
        });
        if (problems.length) {
            toast('The order was created, but it did not store everything sent: ' + problems.join('; ') +
                  '. Check it in the Sales Order module.', 'warn', 25000);
            dbg('read-back mismatch: ' + problems.join('; '), 'warn');
        } else {
            dbg('read-back verified ' + sentSale.length + ' line(s)');
        }
    } catch (e) {
        dbg('read-back failed (the order was still created): ' + (e && e.message || e), 'warn');
    }
}

        document.getElementById('setStatus').value = String(e.defaultStatusId || 10);
        document.getElementById('setModuleOpt').value = e.moduleOpt || 'low';
        document.getElementById('setDebug').checked = !!e.debug;
        const admin = document.getElementById('dsAdminSection');
        if (admin) admin.style.display = FBLib.Settings.isAdmin() ? '' : 'none';
        refreshLock();
    }
    function refreshLock() {
        const allowed = FBLib.Settings.userEditingAllowed();
        const b = document.getElementById('dsLockBadge');
        if (b) b.style.display = (!allowed && !FBLib.Settings.isAdmin()) ? 'block' : 'none';
        const lb = document.getElementById('dsLockBtn');
        if (lb) lb.textContent = allowed ? 'Lock user editing' : 'Unlock user editing';
    }
    function read() {
        return {
            ruleCfName: document.getElementById('setCfName').value || DEFAULTS.ruleCfName,
            manualOverrideCfValue: document.getElementById('setManualCf').value,
            defaultRuleSource: document.getElementById('setRuleSource').value,
            defaultRuleCfName: document.getElementById('setRuleCf').value.trim(),
            defaultRuleAliases: document.getElementById('setRuleAliases').value,
            defaultRulePattern: document.getElementById('setRulePattern').value,
            defaultRuleApplyToNewLines: document.getElementById('setRuleApply').checked,
            defaultRuleRequireNumericMatch: document.getElementById('setRuleNumeric').checked,
            defaultStatusId: intOf(document.getElementById('setStatus').value) || 10,
            moduleOpt: document.getElementById('setModuleOpt').value,
            debug: document.getElementById('setDebug').checked,
        };
    }
    async function apply() {
        DEBUG = !!pref('debug');
        _moduleOpt = pref('moduleOpt') || 'low';
        if (DEBUG) { try { if (!window._dbgApi) window._dbgApi = C.mountDebugDrawer(); } catch (_) {} }
        await loadSoItemCustomFields();
        if (_customer) {
            resolveDefaultRules(_customer);
            renderRuleBanner();
            _bpCache.clear();
            await repriceAllLines();
        }
        refreshTotals();
        FBLib.Common.closeDrawer('setOverlay');
    }
    return {
        open: fill,
        save: async function () {
            const p = read();
            Object.keys(p).forEach(k => FBLib.Settings.setUserKey(k, p[k]));
            if (!FBLib.Settings.saveUser()) { toast('User editing is locked by an administrator.', 'error'); return; }
            await apply();
            toast('Settings saved.', 'success');
        },
        reset: async function () {
            if (!window.confirm('Reset your settings for this screen to the defaults?')) return;
            FBLib.Settings.clearUser();
            fill(); await apply();
        },
        publish: async function () {
            if (!FBLib.Settings.isAdmin()) return;
            if (!window.confirm('Publish these values as the default for everyone?')) return;
            FBLib.Settings.publishMaster(read());
            toast('Published as the default for everyone.', 'success');
            await apply();
        },
        toggleLock: function () {
            if (!FBLib.Settings.isAdmin()) return;
            const nowLocked = FBLib.Settings.userEditingAllowed();
            FBLib.Settings.setLock(nowLocked);
            refreshLock();
            toast('User editing is now ' + (nowLocked ? 'LOCKED' : 'unlocked') + '.', 'info');
        },
    };
})();

document.getElementById('ruleSearch').addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
    const items = [...document.querySelectorAll('#ruleList .rule-item:not(.dis)')];
    if (e.key === 'Enter') {
        e.preventDefault();
        const hl = document.querySelector('#ruleList .rule-item.hl') || items[0];
        if (hl) {
            const rid = hl.getAttribute('data-rid');
            pickRule(rid === 'none' ? null : intOf(rid));
        }
    } else if (e.key === 'ArrowDown' || e.key === 'ArrowUp') {
        e.preventDefault();
        const cur = items.findIndex(i => i.classList.contains('hl'));
        const next = e.key === 'ArrowDown' ? Math.min(items.length - 1, cur + 1) : Math.max(0, cur - 1);
        items.forEach(i => i.classList.remove('hl'));
        if (items[next]) { items[next].classList.add('hl'); items[next].scrollIntoView({ block: 'nearest' }); }
    }
});
